lessonTitle: 7. One and zero are special numbers
lessonTitleEnglish: One and zero are special numbers
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 5 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Multiplying or dividing by 1 does not change a number; a number divided by itself is 1.
stages.headlineEnglish: Multiplying or dividing by 1 does not change a number; a number divided by itself is 1.

stages.headline: Adding or subtracting 0 leaves a number unchanged; a number minus itself is 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: Adding or subtracting 0 leaves a number unchanged; a number minus itself is 0.

stages.headline: Any number times 0 is 0; 0 divided by any number is 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: Any number times 0 is 0; 0 divided by any number is 0.

stages.headline: But we cannot divide by 0. Why? Try dividing 5 by 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: But we cannot divide by 0. Why? Try dividing 5 by 0.

optionsQuiz.feedbackIncorrect: 🤔 Not quite. The correct answer is {correctText}.

stages.headline: Which number x makes x · 57 = 57?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. 57 is unchanged, so we multiplied by 1. 2. x = 1.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. 57 is unchanged, so we multiplied by 1. 2. x = 1.
